mutations.name: superseded lines are kept
kills: plan.seed drops a superseded line and keeps its replacement with date and quote ref

mutations.name: tasks without done_when are listed
kills: plan.seed lists only open, done_when-bearing, domain-tagged tasks in priority order

mutations.name: domain tag filter is dropped
kills: plan.seed lists only open, done_when-bearing, domain-tagged tasks in priority order

mutations.name: parser errors lose their line numbers
kills: plan.seed returns the parser line-numbered errors for a malformed digest
